label: Generic release-style QC for an iPSC-derived cell product. Limits are configurable defaults; your QA/regulatory team owns the final specification.

criteria.basis: FDA (2008) CMC guidance for human somatic cell therapy INDs recommends a minimum release viability of 70%; justify any product-specific limit.
Product-specific identity/purity limit on the request's target_marker; must be set per product (no universal value).
Residual undifferentiated iPSCs are a tumorigenicity risk; the limit and assay sensitivity are product-specific.
Sterility testing per USP <71> / Ph. Eur. 2.6.1 (or validated rapid method, Ph. Eur. 2.6.27).
Mycoplasma testing per Ph. Eur. 2.6.7 / USP <63>.
Bacterial endotoxins per USP <85> / Ph. Eur. 2.6.14; the limit depends on dose and route (K/M), so it must be set per product.
Genetic stability of the iPSC line (G-banding or targeted assay, e.g. 20q11.21 ddPCR) before banking/release.
